activities.name: Monserrate Sanctuary Funicular & Panoramic Views
activities.description: Ride the historic funicular or cable car up the sacred cerro of Monserrate to 3,152 meters above sea level — the entire sprawling grid of Bogotá stretching to the horizon below, with the Andes framing the city on all sides. Home to a beloved 17th-century pilgrimage sanctuary at the summit.
activities.duration_note: Round-trip transport included. Go early morning for clearest views before cloud cover builds

activities.name: Museo del Oro — Gold Museum
activities.description: Explore the world's largest collection of pre-Hispanic gold artifacts — over 55,000 pieces crafted by the Muisca, Zenú, Tairona, and Calima peoples — in one of the most important and visually stunning anthropological museums in Latin America. Free entry on Sundays.
activities.duration_note: Free entry on Sundays. Located in La Candelaria — use Uber, not street taxis

activities.name: Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral
activities.description: Descend into an extraordinary underground Roman Catholic cathedral carved entirely inside a working salt mine — 180 meters below ground, with dramatic arched salt-stone nave corridors, a 16-meter salt-carved cross, and a subterranean plaza that took decades to excavate.
activities.duration_note: Price includes round-trip transit from Bogotá. Book in advance on weekends — highly popular

activities.name: Villa de Leyva Colonial Town Exploration
activities.description: Wander one of the best-preserved colonial towns in South America — Villa de Leyva's vast, unpaved Plaza Mayor is one of the largest town squares on the continent, surrounded by whitewashed 16th-century facades, artisan shops, and a landscape of dramatic high-altitude desert valleys.
activities.duration_note: Price is one-way bus from Bogotá Terminal Salitre. Best enjoyed as a full weekend — book accommodation ahead

activities.name: Chicaque Natural Park Cloud Forest Hike
activities.description: Hike down into the misty oak and fern cloud forest canyon of Chicaque Natural Park just outside Bogotá — a surprisingly wild escape from the capital, with trails descending through moss-draped canopy to valley overlooks where the highland fog rolls in and out between the trees.

activities.name: Ajiaco Santafereño & Chocolate Completo
activities.description: Start with Ajiaco Santafereño at Antigua Santa Fe in La Candelaria — a uniquely Bogotano thick soup of three potato varieties, chicken, corn, and guasca herbs served with capers, cream, and avocado — then finish at Pastelería Florida for Chocolate Completo: hot chocolate with a slab of salty farmer's cheese dropped directly in the mug.

activities.name: Paloquemao Market — Tropical Fruit & Lechona
activities.description: Navigate the extraordinary Plaza de Mercado de Paloquemao — Bogotá's most vibrant wholesale market — grazing through vendors selling mountains of exotic tropical fruits (maracuyá, lulo, pitahaya, tomate de árbol), then heading to the back stalls for a plate of lechona, a whole stuffed roast pig.

activities.name: Andrés Carne de Res — Theatrical Party Restaurant
activities.description: Experience the legendary Andrés Carne de Res in Chía — a sprawling multi-floor theatrical party restaurant unlike anything else on Earth, where hundreds of dangling decorations, live bands, costumed performers, and an electric crowd of locals turn a dinner into a full-night spectacle. Or visit the condensed Andrés DC in Zona T.
activities.duration_note: Cover COP 30,000 — reservations strongly recommended on weekends

activities.name: Tejo Hall — Gunpowder Targets & Beer
activities.description: Play Colombia's national sport at a traditional Tejo hall — hurling heavy metal pucks across a muddy clay lane at small gunpowder-packed targets that explode with a satisfying BANG when hit, all while drinking cheap Águila beers at plastic tables with loud, enthusiastic locals.
activities.duration_note: No cover — pay for beer buckets (~COP 70,000 per group). One of Colombia's most unique social experiences

activities.name: Comuna 13 Graffiti & Outdoor Escalator Tour
activities.description: Explore the extraordinary urban transformation of Medellín's once-notorious Comuna 13 — massive, vivid street murals documenting the neighborhood's violent past and resilient present, accessed via the world's first outdoor urban escalators installed to connect hillside communities to the city below.
activities.duration_note: Tip-based or standard tour price. Go with a local guide for deeper neighborhood context

activities.name: El Peñol Rock Climb & Guatapé Lake Town
activities.description: Climb the 740 steps built into the crack of El Peñón de Guatapé — a 200-meter granite monolith rising from a vast reservoir — for a stunning panoramic view of the fractured lake landscape below, then explore the colorful zócalo-decorated streets of the nearby colonial town of Guatapé.
activities.duration_note: Price is rock access fee only — add bus from Medellín (~COP 20,000 each way). Full day trip including transit

activities.name: Metrocable & Parque Arví Highland Forest
activities.description: Ride Medellín's remarkable integrated public transit system — metro to cable car to a second cable car — soaring high over densely packed hillside barrios before arriving at Parque Arví, a cool highland forest reserve with hiking trails and local artisan markets above the city.
activities.duration_note: Total metro and cable car fares. One of the world's most innovative urban transit experiences

activities.name: Valle de Cocora Wax Palm Trek
activities.description: Hike through the mist-covered Valle de Cocora — a surreal landscape of Colombia's national tree, the towering 60-meter wax palm, rising improbably from green rolling hillsides like giant candles. The loop trail winds through cloud forest, hummingbird gardens, and river crossings.
activities.duration_note: Price includes Willys jeep and trail fees. Depart by 6:30 AM — afternoon fog and rain are near-guaranteed. Hike counter-clockwise for best morning light on the palms

activities.name: Immersive Coffee Finca Farm Experience
activities.description: Visit an active family coffee farm in the heart of the Eje Cafetero — hand-picking ripe red cherries from the plants, pulping and washing the beans, learning the drying and roasting process, and cupping the final product in a region that produces some of the world's most celebrated single-origin coffee.

activities.name: Bandeja Paisa at Mondongo's
activities.description: Conquer Colombia's most legendary mountain platter at the iconic Restaurante Mondongo's — a Bandeja Paisa loaded with red beans, white rice, ground meat, crispy chicharrón, fried egg, sweet plantain, chorizo, and a corn arepa, all on one massive tray. A true Antioquian feat of appetite.

activities.name: Arepa de Choclo & Coffee in Salento
activities.description: Eat the Coffee Axis's most beloved street snack — a fresh Arepa de Choclo, a thick sweet corn griddle cake oozing with salty quesillo cheese, sold hot by street vendors in Salento's main plaza — paired with a cup of locally grown drip coffee from one of the town's traditional cafeterías.

activities.name: Son Havana Salsa Night & Parque Lleras Rooftop
activities.description: Dance in Medellín's most authentic live salsa venues — Son Havana in Laureles for a sweaty, expert crowd of local dancers to heavy live salsa bands — then shift to Poblado's Parque Lleras area for rooftop cocktails and city views at The Envy Roof Top on The Charlee Hotel.
activities.duration_note: Salsa venue cover COP 15,000–25,000. Never leave drinks unattended in Medellín nightlife settings

activities.name: Cartagena Historic Walled City & Getsemaní Walk
activities.description: Walk the massive 13-kilometer coral stone ramparts of Cartagena's UNESCO-listed old city — cannon-lined bastions overlooking the Caribbean — then descend into the colorful, vibrant Getsemaní neighborhood with its street art, flower-balconied plazas, and the beating heart of the city's local culture.
activities.duration_note: Free self-guided walk. Be cautious in Getsemaní after dark — verify prices explicitly before accepting any street service

activities.name: Castillo San Felipe de Barajas
activities.description: Explore the most sophisticated Spanish military fortress ever built in the Americas — Castillo San Felipe's extraordinary honeycomb of tunnels, ramps, and strategic platforms was engineered to be acoustically sensitive, allowing defenders to hear approaching footsteps through the stone walls.

activities.name: Rosario Islands Speedboat Day Charter
activities.description: Speed across 45 kilometers of Caribbean Sea to the Islas del Rosario — a protected archipelago of coral reef atolls with crystalline turquoise water — snorkeling pristine reefs, lounging on white sand islets, and eating fresh ceviche on wooden platforms above the water.
activities.duration_note: Book through established operators — avoid unregistered beach touts. Standard day-tour price

activities.name: Tayrona National Park Jungle Coastal Trek
activities.description: Trek dense jungle trails through one of South America's most biodiverse coastal parks — howler monkeys overhead and ancient Tairona stone paths underfoot — emerging onto the spectacular isolated beaches of Cabo San Juan del Guía, where jungle cliffs plunge straight into the Caribbean.
activities.duration_note: Foreigner high-season entry. Park has mandatory closures several times yearly for indigenous spiritual cleaning — verify status at parquesnacionales.gov.co before booking. Overnight camping available

activities.name: Ciudad Perdida — Lost City Trek
activities.description: Undertake one of the most extraordinary archaeological treks in the Americas — four days through dense jungle, crossing rivers and ascending 1,200 stone steps to reach the Tairona city of Teyuna, built centuries before Machu Picchu and still guarded by the indigenous Kogi and Wiwa peoples.
activities.location: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, Magdalena
activities.duration_note: 4 days / 3 nights. All-inclusive fixed government-regulated price — no independent access. Must book through licensed operators only (Wiwa Tours, Expotur, Magic Tour). Carry cash for entire trip

activities.name: Arroz con Coco & Arepa de Huevo — Getsemaní Street Food
activities.description: Eat the Caribbean coast's two signature dishes — whole crispy fried red snapper served with sweet coconut rice and patacones at La Cevichería inside the old city, then hunt down a street cauldron in Plaza de la Trinidad for an Arepa de Huevo: a corn arepa stuffed with seasoned meat and a whole egg, deep-fried until golden.

activities.name: Café Havana & Plaza de la Trinidad Street Party
activities.description: Start the evening at the Plaza de la Trinidad in Getsemaní — cold beers from corner tiendas, street performers, and a local crowd gathering organically every night — then move to Café Havana for the best live Afro-Cuban jazz and salsa in Cartagena, with a dance floor that heats up well past midnight.
activities.duration_note: Plaza street party is free. Café Havana cover COP 40,000

activities.name: Café del Mar Sunset Cocktails on the Walls
activities.description: Claim a table at the iconic Café del Mar — perched directly on top of Cartagena's ancient coral stone sea walls — for expertly made cocktails as the Caribbean sun drops into the water and the old city turns gold behind you. The classic upscale Cartagena experience.

activities.name: Cali Salsa Masterclass
activities.description: Take a private lesson from a world-class Cali salsa dancer — one of the fastest, footwork-focused styles of salsa on earth, developed in the city's working-class barrios — learning the tight, syncopated steps and partner dynamics of a dance tradition deeply woven into Caleño identity.
activities.duration_note: Private hourly rate. Group classes available at lower cost

activities.name: San Antonio Historic Barrio Walk
activities.description: Wander Cali's most charming and bohemian neighborhood — the hillside Barrio San Antonio, with its brightly painted colonial homes, artisan cafés, independent bookshops, and the steps of the Iglesia de San Antonio offering sweeping views over the entire Cauca Valley at sunset.
activities.duration_note: Free self-guided walk. At dusk, buy artisanal viche (traditional Afro-Colombian sugarcane spirit) from street vendors on the church steps

activities.name: Pacific Coast Humpback Whale Watching
activities.description: Board a small skiff from a remote Pacific eco-lodge to encounter humpback whales along Colombia's wild Chocó coastline — one of the densest humpback congregation zones in the world, where mothers and calves breach and slap the water against a backdrop of untouched jungle cliffs.
activities.duration_note: Seasonal: July through October. Accessible only via small regional turbo-prop flights from Medellín — baggage limited to 10–15kg. Yellow fever vaccination required

activities.name: Puerto Nariño Amazon Eco-Village River Trip
activities.description: Travel up the Amazon River by public boat from Leticia to Puerto Nariño — Colombia's most sustainable town, entirely car-free, built on the riverbank inside the jungle — for village walks, canoe trips into flooded forest, and encounters with pink river dolphins in their natural habitat.
activities.duration_note: Price is one-way public riverboat from Leticia (~2.5 hrs). Leticia accessible only by direct flight from Bogotá. Yellow fever vaccination and malaria prophylactics required

activities.name: Amacayacu Amazon Wildlife Expedition
activities.description: Spend multiple days deep in the Amacayacu National Park with indigenous Tikuna guides — tracking pink river dolphins, spotting giant river otters, hundreds of macaw species, pygmy marmosets, and anacondas in the primary Amazon rainforest. One of the most biodiverse stretches of jungle on the planet.
activities.duration_note: Daily rate includes lodge and guide. 3-day minimum recommended. Heavy DEET essential — pack dry bags for all electronics and documents

activities.name: Encocado de Pescado & Lulada at Mercado Alameda
activities.description: Taste Cali's two iconic flavors at the Mercado de Alameda — Encocado de Pescado, Pacific coast fish simmered in fresh-squeezed coconut milk with wild culantro and peppers, then cool down with a Lulada, Cali's signature street drink of mashed lulo fruit crushed with lime juice and condensed milk over ice.

activities.name: La Topa Tolondra — Temple of Cali Salsa
activities.description: Dance at the undisputed cathedral of Cali Salsa — La Topa Tolondra, where Monday and Thursday nights draw the city's best local dancers alongside intermediate travelers in a sweaty, joyful, authentic celebration of Cali Salsa Brava. Then move to Zaperoco for classic vinyl records and old-school Caleño style.
activities.duration_note: Cover COP 15,000. Mondays and Thursdays are the legendary nights
